page.layout: One page of text in a single column; margin notes left (reference "Matth. XXVII.") and right ("Ambiguus intellectus in Euangelista"); a woodcut ornament below the text; signature at the foot right.

main_text.p: ὄρνεον ἐφίπταδς σαρκοφάγον: Paucis post diebus, ij qui Cleomenis cruci affixum corpus custodiebant, viderunt magnum serpentem capiti ejus circumplexum, & faciem velantem tegentémque, ne qua carniuora auis attingeret. Vbi utrumque habes, & custodiri solitos mortuos; & aues faciem in primis inuolasse. Possis ad hanc Custodiam illud Euangelistæ referre: Ἔχετε κυστωδίαν, ἀπάγετε: Habetis custodiam, abite. Quæ Pilati vox fuit ad Iudæos petentes asseruari monumentum. Videtur autem intelligere custodiam, quæ paullo ante ad crucem. nisi quis malit, Habete custodiam; quasi ab imperante, & indignanter dante. Vox enim Græca in utrumuis valet.

page.notes: Left margin: "Matth. XXVII." Right margin: "Ambiguus intellectus in Euangelistâ" (small italic). Greek words transcribed as legible; the Greek on the first line and "ἔχετε κυστωδίαν" are uncertain in places. The woodcut ornament is not text. Some words in the italic lines are uncertain: "[?]" not added where the reading is clear.
